embedding.openaiNotice: With OpenAI, this knowledge base's document text and your questions are sent to OpenAI servers. Use "No vectors" for sensitive material.
embedding.reindexNeeded: The model changed. Reindex to apply it to search.
embedding.none: No vectors (keyword, code, folder search — default)

hint.none: Searches by keyword (FTS5), code symbols, file paths, and folder info with no API key. Enough for most cases.
hint.local-hash: The old default. Evaluation showed almost no quality gain, so new knowledge bases don't use it.
hint.openai: Also finds passages with similar meaning. Calls the OpenAI API for indexing and each question (uses the OpenAI key in Settings › API keys).

settings.title: Knowledge base settings
settings.descriptionHint: Describing the material helps search find better matches.

autoIndex.label: Auto index
autoIndex.hint: When on, files are indexed as soon as you add them. When off, press Re-index yourself.

hint.auto: Searches locally and looks further only when evidence is weak. Right for most people.
hint.fast: Local search only. No extra model calls or document browsing — fastest.
hint.deep: Gathers more evidence, and Codex/Claude read the source documents they need.
hint.semantic: Also searches by meaning in knowledge bases with an OpenAI index. Falls back to local search otherwise.

notice.semantic_unavailable: No semantic index, so local search was used.
notice.embed_failed: Semantic search failed, so keyword search was used.

notice.timeout: Search timed out, so the answer has no knowledge base evidence.
notice.kb_skipped: Knowledge bases without an index were skipped.
notice.version_conflict: Sources mention different versions. Check the versions in the answer.
notice.codebase_missing: A codebase folder could not be found and was skipped.

folder_not_allowed.cause: This location cannot be linked, such as a home or system folder.
folder_not_allowed.fix: Pick a project folder and link it again.

kb_meta_unreadable.cause: The knowledge base information file could not be read.
